newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Micrion cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Micrion cut to hold.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Mart FitzGerald said in a research note he lowered his recommendation on Micrion Corp to hold from buy.
-- He said the company reported fiscal third quarter earnings of $0.13 per share on revenues of $14.1 million, versus his estimates of $0.20 per share and $13.5 million in revenues.
-- "The weakened EPS is due to margin erosion resulting from a product-mix shift to primarily low-margin products, research and development and lab applications," he said.
-- Micrion shares were off 1/8 at 13-3/4 in early Nasdaq trade.
